title: Travis Scott's Cactus Jack Debuts Vice City Uniforms With Nike Ahead of 'Grand Theft Auto VI'
text:
Travis Scott's Cactus Jack Debuts Vice City Uniforms With Nike Ahead of 'Grand Theft Auto VI' Search sneakers, brands, or styles... Sign In SHOP STYLE SNEAKERS MUSIC SPORTS POP CULTURE BETS COVER STORIES VERZUZ WATCH COMMUNITY Style Travis Scott's Cactus Jack Debuts Vice City Uniforms With Nike Ahead of 'Grand Theft Auto VI'
 The Heat will play the Bucks while decked out in Vice City gear on the eve of the new 'GTA' game's release.
 By Trace William Cowen November 6, 2026 Comments Comment Save Share Travis Scott Post, shop, and read Visit fandom Comments Comments Image via Cactus Jack/Nike We told you last month that Grand Theft Auto VI , in a shrewd bit of marketing, would be hitting the court in Miami on the eve of the surefire blockbuster’s release. Now, this fiction-meets-reality moment has its own uniform.
 Friday (Nov. 6), we got our first look at the official Vice City duds. Travis Scott ’s Cactus Jack and Nike partnered with the NBA and the Miami Heat to craft the look, and lucky for fans, they’ll have the chance to take home their own GTA VI -celebrating pieces on Nov. 18. As previously announced, that’s the same day the Heat, wearing exclusive on-court Cactus Jack x Nike uniforms, will play the Milwaukee Bucks .
 Both the Swingman Vice City jersey and the Vice City shorts will be made available for fans on game day, albeit in limited quantities.
 Below, get a closer look at what Cactus Jack and Nike have cooked up.
 Scott is also featured on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album , joining Cardi B and Tame Impala , among numerous others, on the soundtrack companion to what will certainly become the biggest blockbuster in video game history.
